name: YardSwaps
long_about:
YardSwaps is a US marketplace for buying and selling used industrial and commercial equipment: fleet trucks, trailers, generators, compressors, forklifts, excavators, farm and landscaping gear, shop equipment and more, across 33 categories.

Got a machine sitting idle, a donor unit or spare parts on a shelf? Snap a photo, AI fills in the listing, and buyers nearby find it by category, name or part number and make an offer.

Free to list. No listing fee and no cut of the sale: every deal is a local pickup where the buyer sees it run, then pays the seller directly. New sellers get free listing boosts.

Equipment businesses get a free storefront with bulk upload and listing stats.

On the web, iPhone and Android:
